text:
Lina (Customer Success): FYI — Acme reports a subtle change in how the model answers after our v4.3 rollout yesterday. They say replies are punchier with fewer lead-ins and one-sentence clarifications removed. They pasted before/after examples. Can we triage?

Julia (Support): thanks — can you paste the customer's before/after?

Lina (Customer Success): pasted what they sent:

```before
Q: How do I reset my API key?
A: To reset your API key, go to Settings → API keys and click 'Rotate'. Follow the prompts.
```

```after
Q: How do I reset my API key?
A: Go to Settings → API keys and click 'Rotate'.
```

Lina (Customer Success): customer reports token count dropped ~20-30% and they noticed a removed clarifying sentence in several help flows. They're worried some users will miss the extra step.

Raj (ML Engineering): interesting. We didn't change sampling defaults. v4.3 included weight updates + some kernel-level compile optimizations. Could be a small distribution shift. Do we have the API request metadata (model, sampling params, request id)?

Lina (Customer Success): request_id: r-0a1b2c3d; model: redwood/fastgen-4.3; temperature: 0.0; top_p: 1.0; max_tokens: 256; prompt length ~48 tokens. Customer says both responses came from same request id (they saved raw text).

Raj (ML Engineering): temp=0.0 — deterministic, so a change likely comes from model weights/decoder behavior. A 20-30% token delta across similar prompts is notable. I'll run a quick diff on our regression set and compute avg answer-length and counts of lead-in/hedging tokens ("Sure", "Here's how").

Mikhail (SRE): FYI deploy-bot shows rollout completed at 1755549000. No infra changes in that region around the same time.

deploy-bot: model redwood/fastgen-4.3 rollout finished at 2025-11-03T14:45:00Z :white_check_mark:

Raj (ML Engineering): can someone try to repro locally with the exact call? Example curl below.

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/fastgen-4.3","input":"How do I reset my API key?","temperature":0.0,"max_tokens":200}'
```

Julia (Support): I'll ask the customer to run the same call and share the raw JSON response (they agreed). They also asked whether we can rollback if we can't explain the change quickly.

Raj (ML Engineering): I'll start a batch evaluation on the canonical support prompts and output a short report (avg tokens, fraction of responses that include an extra clarifying sentence). Tagging @Mikhail for logs on r-0a1b2c3d.

Mikhail (SRE): pulling traces now. If request/infra looks fine, it's probably a model distribution/regression rather than an API bug.

Julia (Support): marking ticket P2. Lina — please tell Acme we're investigating and we can offer a temporary pin to redwood/fastgen-4.2 for their workspace while we look.

Lina (Customer Success): will do, I'll offer the pin and ask them to share the raw response JSON. :+1: 

Raj (ML Engineering): plan: 1) reproduce via curl 2) run batch eval and compute statistics 3) if confirmed, recommend rollback or deploy a calibration variant that nudges for more elaboration. I'll report back in ~2 hours.

Julia (Support): thanks all — keep me posted and I'll update the customer thread.
